build_kind: Development build; demonstration timings are not a performance benchmark.
recording_source: Bundled public John F. Kennedy speech excerpt, samples/jfk.wav, routed through a private PipeWire virtual microphone. No physical microphone or unrelated desktop is included.
capture_method: wf-recorder captured the real Cantrip layer-shell HUD and Foot/Neovim editor on a dedicated 1280x800 Hyprland output. Only idle lead-in and trailing time were trimmed; no frames were retimed or stages simulated. The recorder's incorrect full-range metadata was corrected to match the native screenshot before WebM encoding.
recording_control: The configured toggle/start/stop command path was automated outside the editor. This recording does not claim a physical hotkey test.
cleanup_endpoint: Explicitly enabled local Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint
transcript: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you. Ask what you can do for your country.
